entities.summary: Hope Wakio Mwanake is a Kenyan entrepreneur and scientist. She is regarded as one of the emerging young entrepreneurs from Africa. In December 2019, she made headlines for her efforts in building houses with abandoned plastic bottles to eradicate plastic pollution in Kenya.
